subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff — next steps after discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ng <sara.ng@acme.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff — next steps after discovery

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about ACME's plans for integrating LLM features into your support and knowledge workflows. Quick recap from our side:

- Goals you called out: improve KB search relevance, automate suggested replies, and reduce support triage time by 30%.
- Success criteria we discussed: precision/recall on your eval prompt set, latency under 300ms for 95th pct, and cost target <$0.003/token for the bulk inference path.

Next step: we recommend a 45-minute evaluation kickoff where we can:
- Align on the trial plan and success criteria
- Share the evaluation prompt set and example data requirements
- Walk through environment/setup (tokenization, payload size, infra) and security requirements
- Schedule a technical deep-dive demo with our runtime engineer if useful

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2027-04-06 15:00–15:45
- Wed 2027-04-07 11:00–11:45

I've attached a short evaluation plan (redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf) that outlines the trial scope and deliverables. If those slots don't work, you can pick a time on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-30m

Confirmed attendees we suggest: you + product/security partner at ACME, me (AE), Connor (solutions engineer), and Rishi (security lead) for a quick Q&A. Let me know which time works and whether you'd like Connor or Rishi to cover anything specific.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation kickoff — next steps after discovery

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and thanks for the clear recap. We're keen to move forward.

We can do Tue 2027-04-06 15:00–15:45 PST.

A few notes/questions before the kickoff:
- Please loop in Rishi from security; Dave (cc'd) will be on the call for infra questions.
- We'd like the kickoff to include a short run-through of what telemetry/logs we can expect and any PII/data handling considerations.
- Will you be able to share the prompt set format ahead of time (CSV/JSON)? If possible, send sample templates so our data team can start prepping.

I'll assume the Calendly link is valid — I also sent a tentative invite to the slot.

Best,

Perfect — thanks Sara, and thanks for adding Dave. Looping in Rishi as requested.

Agenda for the 45-minute kickoff (we'll send a calendar invite shortly):
1) 5m introductions and goals alignment
2) 10m review of evaluation plan (scope, timeline, deliverables) — doc attached
3) 15m data/prompt set requirements and handoff format (we'll provide JSON/CSV templates)
4) 10m infra/security checklist and telemetry expectations (Rishi will cover)
5) 5m next steps and owners

Attachments included: redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf (same doc with inline notes). We'll also post a Google Drive link to the prompt templates before the call: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c_eval_plan

Connor, can you be prepared to speak to any sample inference payload sizes and batching recommendations? Rishi, we'll be grateful for a quick overview of the security checklist items we typically review.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
